params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $head=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  Write-Output "VERIFY_HEAD=$head"
  git restore -- .verification/function-status.json .verification/stage-status.json MHW-DEBUG-ALL.log
  if(Test-Path BuildLogs){ Remove-Item BuildLogs -Recurse -Force }
  Write-Output 'CLEAN_STATUS_BEGIN'; git status --short --branch; Write-Output 'CLEAN_STATUS_END'
  $pwsh=(Get-Command pwsh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
  Write-Output "PWSH=$pwsh"
  & $pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Verify-Release.ps1
  $code=$LASTEXITCODE
  Write-Output "VERIFY_EXIT=$code"
  Write-Output 'POST_STATUS_BEGIN'; git status --short; Write-Output 'POST_STATUS_END'
  Write-Output "VERIFY_HEAD_AFTER=$((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim())"
  exit $code
} finally { Pop-Location }
